Our ESG policy

We firmly believe that sustainable value creation goes hand in hand with a responsible investment approach.

We are convinced that financial performance and environmental and social impact are closely linked.

Our commitment
Active integration of ESG criteria
We are aware of the significant impact of real estate on the environment and the importance of social and governance issues in any meaningful and sustainable investment strategy. Therefore, we are committed to acting as a responsible investor and minimizing the effects of operating our real estate assets.

Sanfreight supports global sustainability and is committed to actively integrating Environmental, Social, and Governance dimensions into the management of its assets.
Our conviction
The links between performance and impact
At Sanfreight, we firmly believe that financial performance and environmental and social impact are inherently linked.

We are convinced that a responsible investment strategy is inseparable from significant value creation. In other words, for us, a company's performance cannot be considered independently of its footprint on the world.
Our promise
Sustainable performance
We believe that true value can only be created through sustainable performance. For us, this means investing responsibly, managing our assets with care, and honoring our commitments to our partners and shareholders.

By placing ESG criteria at the core of our approach, we aim to ensure the long-term financial performance of our investments and contribute to a better world for all. This is our promise at Sanfreight.
Another step forward for Sanfreight with the creation of its ESG charter.

We have taken a further step in our commitment as a responsible investor by drawing up an ESG charter. This charter guides our consideration of ESG issues throughout the investment cycle.

However, we maintain a certain degree of flexibility: while we encourage the application of the ESG pillars, we do not systematically bind ourselves to them, recognizing that each situation is unique and requires a tailored approach.

Key points of our approach

  • Environment

  • Social

  • Governance

/01

Environment

For its future real estate development and restructuring operations, Sanfreight encourages environmentally friendly real estate projects that meet the latest energy standards and whose natural and renewable resources are used in construction processes in order to reduce the energy consumption of buildings.

/02

Social

Sanfreight places people at the heart of its investment projects. In the field, we ensure that we collaborate with service providers who respect a charter for environmental management while considering the health and safety of their employees, including on construction sites. Internally, we consider that our employees are our greatest asset: we pay particular attention to their well-being and their working conditions.

/03

Governance

The alternative investment funds created by Sanfreight are subject to the regulatory obligations of the AIFM for the approval of investments, the fight against money laundering and conflicts of interest. Sanfreight is committed to communicating transparently with its investors and partners.

Our 4-pillar approach

Project sourcing

Responsible investment

Committed asset management

Eco-responsible commitment

01

Project sourcing

Sanfreight systematically carries out in-depth due diligence on its investment projects, ensuring that essential ESG criteria are identified in the context of new real estate developments or real estate revitalization involving major works.

02

Responsible investment

As part of its approach to value creation through responsible investment, Sanfreight ensures that ESG criteria are integrated into its management of the real estate operation, including the use of external service providers, while remaining committed to the tenants and respecting their conduct.

03

Committed asset management

Regarding the operational management of its assets, Sanfreight pays particular attention to the proper execution of its construction sites, whether in terms of human management of workers to protect their health and safety or in terms of waste management.

04

Eco-responsible commitment

Within Sanfreight, all employees are committed to implementing environmentally friendly practices on a daily basis in order to reduce their carbon footprint (paperless office, waste recycling, reduced water and energy consumption, etc.).
